hypothesis: Caught opening exceptions must not leave a usable connection or let cleanup replace the initiating error. Schema recovery follows the actual commit boundary.
correction: All failed openings discard the connection before close. All four schema creation/migration paths use existing rollback/discard cleanup. Original failures and SQLite store-domain classification survive cleanup failure.
review_coverage: SQLiteEventStore constructor and schema opening/migration paths
integrity-state validation cache and coherent read wrapper
runtime rollback/discard, close and selected append/read callers
existing opening, migration, interruption, snapshot and cleanup controls
limits: Repository-owned injected call-boundary failures only; no external vulnerability or bounty finding.
No guarantee of physical lock release when close itself is interrupted; the store is unusable in that case.
Logical schema equality, not physical database-byte identity.
No arbitrary-instruction asynchronous safety, process/power/device fault qualification or external current-head authority.
No whole-repository audit; no provider SDK, account, credit balance or hosted execution verified.
